title: Write a Testbench: FIFO
constraints: Write a self-checking testbench: top module `tb`, instantiating `sync_fifo4` as `dut`. Report bugs with `$error(...)`, finish with `$finish`.

Specification: a 4-entry, 8-bit synchronous FIFO. On a rising edge, it writes if `wr_en && !full` and reads (pops) if `rd_en && !empty`. Both can happen on the same edge. `dout` = the oldest entry (first-word fall-through, valid while `!empty`). `full = (count == 4)`, `empty = (count == 0)`, and `count` = number of entries. `rst` is synchronous and empties the FIFO.
Stay silent on the correct FIFO and catch all **8** hidden bugs, within 10 s.
hints: Model the FIFO with a SystemVerilog queue: `push_back` on a write, `pop_front` on a read, and check `dout`, `count`, `full` and `empty` against it every cycle.
Directed tests first: write while full, read while empty, simultaneous read + write when full and when empty, reset in the middle of traffic.
Then random traffic with a bias toward the full and empty boundaries. Pointer wrap-around bugs need many cycles.

examples.title: write while full
examples.input: a FIFO that overwrites when full
